PolicyStatement.description: A policy statement attached to a custom Cloud role.

zh-CN.description: 附加到自定义 Cloud 角色的策略语句。

resourceType.description: The second-level resource type targeted by the statement, such as `serving_cluster`, `volume`, `member`, or `org_role`.

zh-CN.description: 策略语句针对的二级资源类型，例如 `serving_cluster`、`volume`、`member` 或 `org_role`。

privileges.description: The atomic privileges granted on the resource type.

zh-CN.description: 针对该资源类型授予的原子权限。

resources.description: The resource instances covered by the statement. Use `*` for all applicable instances. Omit this field when the resource type does not accept instance selection.

zh-CN.description: 策略覆盖的资源实例。使用 `*` 表示所有适用实例；当资源类型不接受实例选择时省略此字段。

scope.description: Reserved for future use. Omit this field.

zh-CN.description: 保留供未来使用，请省略此字段。

roleKind.description: Whether the role is predefined or custom.

zh-CN.description: 角色是预定义角色还是自定义角色。

projectId.description: The project ID for a project-scoped role. This field is absent for an organization-scoped role.

zh-CN.description: 项目级角色所属的项目 ID。组织级角色不返回此字段。

policies.description: The policy statements attached to the role.

zh-CN.description: 附加到角色的策略语句。

count.description: The total number of matching items.

roles.description: The roles returned on this page.

CreateCloudRoleRequest.description: The role to create. Omit projectId for an organization role; include it for a project role.

zh-CN.description: 要创建的角色。组织级角色省略 `projectId`；项目级角色提供该字段。

projectId.description: The project ID for a project-scoped role. Omit this field for an organization-scoped role.

zh-CN.description: 项目级角色所属的项目 ID。组织级角色省略此字段。

roleName.description: The unique role display name within its scope.

zh-CN.description: 角色作用域内唯一的显示名称。

policies.description: The policy statements assigned to the role.

UpdateCloudRoleRequest.description: Fields to update on a custom role.

zh-CN.description: 要更新的自定义角色字段。

projectId.description: The project boundary assertion for a project-scoped role.

zh-CN.description: 项目级角色的项目边界声明。
替换后的角色显示名称。

description.description: The replacement description. Send an empty string to clear it.

zh-CN.description: 替换后的描述。传入空字符串可清除描述。

policies.description: The complete replacement policy set. An empty array is rejected.

zh-CN.description: 完整替换策略集，不接受空数组。

AssignedRole.description: A role directly assigned to a member or group.

zh-CN.description: 直接授予成员或群组的角色。

roleKind.description: Whether the role is predefined or custom.

zh-CN.description: 角色是预定义角色还是自定义角色。

assignedBy.description: The display name of the user who assigned the role, or the raw non-user assigner value.

zh-CN.description: 授予角色的用户显示名称；非用户授予者则返回原始值。

roles.description: The roles assigned within the project.

zh-CN.description: 在该项目中授予的角色。

orgRoles.description: The organization-scoped roles directly assigned to the principal.

zh-CN.description: 直接授予该主体的组织级角色。

projectRoles.description: The project-scoped roles directly assigned to the principal, grouped by project.

zh-CN.description: 直接授予该主体的项目级角色，按项目分组。

email.description: The email address when the principal is a user.

zh-CN.description: 主体为用户时的邮箱地址。

groupId.description: The group ID when the principal is a group.

zh-CN.description: 主体为群组时的群组 ID。

apiKeyId.description: The API key ID when the principal is an API key.

zh-CN.description: 主体为 API Key 时的 API Key ID。

principalName.description: The display name of the principal.

assignedBy.description: The display name of the assigning user, or a raw non-user value such as `system`.

zh-CN.description: 授予者的用户显示名称；非用户授予者返回类似 `system` 的原始值。

assignedAt.description: The assignment time in UTC ISO 8601 format.

zh-CN.description: 授予时间，采用 UTC ISO 8601 格式。

count.description: The total number of matching items.

principals.description: The principals returned on this page.

memberCount.description: The number of members in the group.

count.description: The total number of matching items.

groups.description: The groups returned on this page.

members.description: The members returned on this page.
